・Evidence: Milestone 3

A. Output: Main event.
・Acceptance criteria: The main event will have a number of participants between 100 and 150 due to the capacity of the venue. We will have a registration form for the control of aspects such as food and drinks, as well as the delivery of event merchandise.
・Evidence: Milestone 4

B. Output: Social media posts about the main event.
・Acceptance criteria: We will be doing 3 live broadcasts on our Facebook and TikTok accounts during the event, they will last no more than 10 minutes. Only the Facebook live will be published on the profile, since TikTok does not have the function to save live broadcasts. We will also post short videos of important and planned moments of the event.
・Evidence: Link

C. Output: Interviews with event participants.
・Acceptance criteria: We will interview 10 event participants, so they can give us their feedback and suggestions, which will be recorded.
・Evidence: Link

D. Output: Support to help new users create their Cardano wallets at the event.
・Acceptance criteria: We will record a tutorial that will be constantly playing on a screen during the event. During free time slots during the conferences we will have a person on hand to help people who have questions about creating a Cardano wallet, who will record their address and feedback in a form.
・Evidence: Link

・Acceptance criteria: The Telegram group will have more than 190 members.
